raw_mirror_dna.master_prompt_en: A candid vertical video portrait of a young woman, 18-25 years old, framed from mid-chest to just above the head. She faces the camera directly with her head slightly tilted to the left, a neutral expression, and soft, naturally parted lips. Her long, light platinum blonde hair flows over her shoulders, appearing slightly wind-blown. She wears a form-fitting, off-white, long-sleeved crew-neck top made of a smooth jersey knit, with subtle fabric creasing visible across the torso. A delicate pearl necklace with a central gold-toned Vivienne Westwood Saturn orb pendant rests at her clavicle. Her face exhibits a smooth matte skin texture with zero visible cosmetics. The soft, diffuse ambient lighting emanates from the right, casting gentle highlights without harsh shadows. The background is an indistinct, softly blurred domestic interior with light off-white walls, a subtle sheer curtain on the right, and a blurry decorative light fixture on the left, capturing a calm, casual atmosphere with a clean modern smartphone camera aesthetic.
